messages.content: i found a new place to read today. it is a small chair near the back window of the library.
what did you like about that place?
it was away from the door, so people were not walking past me all the time.
that sounds useful when you want to keep your mind on a book. was the light good there too?
yes. i could see the page without turning on another light. i only stayed for a little while.
even a short visit can help you find a place you would like to use again.
i might go back tomorrow, but i do not want to make it something i must do every day.
you can keep it as a choice. a chair you liked today does not have to become part of every day.
can you write two sentences about it in my voice?
i found a quiet chair near the back window of the library. i liked reading there because people were not always walking past me.
make it about what happened today, not what always happens there.
i read in a chair near the back window of the library today. it was quiet while i was there, and people were not walking past me all the time.
did i say the whole library was quiet?
no. you told me about your place by the back window during your visit.
then just give me a short sentence about that place.
the chair by the back window was a quiet place to read during my visit.
let us use a made up map. the school is north of the park, and the library is south of the park. if i go from the library to the school, which place is between them?
the park is between the library and the school on your map.
which way am i going from the library to the park?
you are going north.
now what way is it from the park to the library?
south.
if i am at the school and want the library, do i go north again?
no. you go south from the school, past the park, to the library.
now add a shop east of the park. does that put it north of the school?
not from what you gave. east of the park does not put the shop north of the school.
can you say the shop is east of the park without knowing a street name?
yes. your map says the shop is east of the park even without a street name.
say it in fewer words.
you do not need a street name to say the shop is east of the park.
just give the place of the shop.
the shop is east of the park.
is this a real map of my town?
no. you asked for a made up map.
which is right: their books are on the table, or there books are on the table?
their books are on the table is right if you mean the books of those people.
can there still be right in a sentence about books?
yes. there are books on the table.
what is different about those two sentences?
their books says whose books they are. there are books says that books are in that place, without saying whose they are.
now make a sentence with both there and their.
their books are over there on the table.
is their about the table?
no. their is about the people whose books they are. there gives a place.
if i want to ask whose books they are, what should i write?
whose books are on the table?
what if i want to ask the place instead?
where are their books?
give me a short place answer.
on the table.
can i answer where with my friends?
not for that meaning. my friends gives people, not the place where the books are.
now write a full answer with their.
their books are on the table.
my friend came to visit, but she has to leave before we thought she would. i am sad because i wanted more time with her.
you can be sad about the short visit and still understand that she needs to leave. would you like help with what to say?
yes. i do not want her to feel she must stay just because i am sad.
it was good to see you. i wish we had more time, but i understand you need to go.
can i add that i would like another visit?
yes. you can say you would like to see her again without choosing a day before she is ready.
write that in the same message.
it was good to see you. i wish we had more time, but i understand you need to go. i would like to see you again when we are both free.
what if that sounds too long for a goodbye at the door?
you could keep it short: it was good to see you. let us talk about another visit later.
does later mean i need to call this evening?
no. later leaves the time open. you have not chosen when to talk again.
now just give me the short goodbye.
it was good to see you. let us talk about another visit later.
can i be sad and still mean that it was good to see her?
yes. those feelings can be true together.
tell a short story about someone carrying a cup of water to a plant. the cup should end on the kitchen table, not near the plant.

a woman put water in a cup and carried it to a plant by the window. she gave the plant some water, then took the cup back to the kitchen. there was still a little water in it, so she put it on the table while she went to get a book. when she returned, the cup was where she had left it. she put the book near it and sat down to read.
give me just the first sentence.
a woman put water in a cup and carried it to a plant by the window.
where is the cup at the end?
on the kitchen table.
is all the original water still inside it?
no. she gave some water to the plant, though a little was still in the cup when she put it on the table.
did the plant move to the kitchen with her?
no. the story only says she took the cup back. it does not say she moved the plant.
write the last part as one sentence about the book and cup.
she put the book near the cup on the kitchen table and sat down to read.
can that sentence make it sound as if she put the book on the cup?
near the cup says it is close to the cup, not on top of it. to make the place more clear, you can say she put the book on the table near the cup.
now give that clear sentence only.
she put the book on the kitchen table near the cup.
is why did you leave early a good question if i do not know whether my friend left early?
it may sound as if you already know she left early. you could first ask whether she did.
write that first question.
did you leave early?
she says no, i stayed until the end. what should i ask next if i want to hear about the visit?
what was the visit like?
should i still ask why she left early?
no. she has told you she did not leave early, so that question would keep a detail she has said is wrong.
what if she says yes, i left early instead?
then you know that part is true. you could ask why, if she wants to talk about it.
can you ask in a kind way without making her explain if she does not want to?
would you like to talk about why you left early?
now write a reply if she says she does not want to talk about it.
okay. we do not have to talk about it.
can you add that i am happy to listen another time without asking a new question?
i can listen another time if you want to talk.
put those two sentences together.
okay. we do not have to talk about it. i can listen another time if you want to talk.
can you give an example with a few books and a little time?
i have a few books to return and a little time before work.
why not a few time?
in that sentence, time is how much time you have. books are things you can count one by one, so a few books works.
can i use a few minutes instead?
yes. you can say one minute or two minutes, so you can also say i have a few minutes before work.
explain with only one minute and two minutes.
you can say one minute or two minutes. a few minutes works in the same way.
now use little without a before it.
i have little time before work.
is that always the same as a little time?
not always. a little time can sound like you have some time. little time can make it sound as if there is not much time.
can you give two examples that make the difference clear?
i have a little time, so we can talk. i have little time, so i need to leave soon.
what if i say a few minutes, so we can talk?
that can work if those few minutes are enough for the talk you want.
make it a full sentence.
i have a few minutes, so we can talk.
does that say i can stay all afternoon?
no. a few minutes is a short time, not a whole afternoon.
my brother plays music while i am reading. i keep saying you always make it impossible to read, but that sounds too much. i just want him to turn the music down right now.
you can ask for the change you need now without making it about every time. could you turn the music down while i read?
give me just the question.
could you turn the music down while i read?
can you add that i am trying to understand a hard page?
i am trying to understand a hard page. could you turn the music down while i read?
he says i can use the other room. i could, but the light there is not good.
then you can explain that the light in this room helps you read. you can ask whether he would turn the music down or use another place for it.
write the request without choosing his answer for him.
the light is better here for reading. could you turn the music down or play it in another room?
does that say he can never play music again?
no. it is about the music while you are reading now.
what if he does turn it down and that is enough?
you can thank him and keep reading.
give me a short thank you.
thank you. that helps me read.
now end without another question.
i hope the page gets more clear as you read.
what is different between i read when my mother came in and i was reading when my mother came in?
i was reading makes clear that the reading was already happening when she came in. i read can be less clear about whether you started then or were already doing it.
use an example where reading starts after she comes in.
my mother came in and asked me to read the letter, so i began reading it.
now use was reading where she comes in during it.
i was reading the letter when my mother came in.
if she asks what i am doing right now, what would i say?
i am reading a letter.
why am instead of was?
am reading is about now. was reading puts the reading in the past.
now she asks what my brother was doing at the same time in the past. he was drawing.
he was drawing while you were reading the letter.
can you write that in my voice?
he was drawing while i was reading the letter.
what if we were both reading instead?
we were both reading when my mother came in.
why were instead of was?
with we in that sentence, use were. with i, use was.
give me one question using were and we.
were we reading when my mother came in?
write the start of a story about a child finding a ball near a garden. then give two possible choices for how it could end.

a child was walking home when he saw a ball near a garden. he stopped and looked around, but nobody was near it. one possible end is that a girl came out of the house and said it was hers. he gave it to her and went home. another possible end is that he asked his father for help, and they tried to find the person who had lost it.
which part is true in both possible stories?
the child saw a ball near a garden while walking home and stopped to look around.
do both possible stories say the girl got the ball?
no. only the first one gives a girl who says the ball is hers.
in the other one, did they find the person?
not yet in the story. it says they tried, but does not say whether they found the person.
can you keep that answer simple?
they tried to find the person, but the story does not say they found anyone.
now choose the first end and write it as one short story.
a child found a ball near a garden while walking home. he stopped and looked around. a girl came out of the house and said the ball was hers, so he gave it to her and went home.
can you tell me what color the ball was?
no. the story does not give its color.
then do not add one if i ask you to tell the same story again.
okay. i will keep the ball without a color unless you choose one.
my sister helped me understand a hard page. i want to thank her, but saying you made it easy is not right. it was still hard, just more clear.
you can thank her for helping you understand without saying the page was easy. thank you for helping me understand that page.
give me just the message.
thank you for helping me understand that page.
can i add that i still need to read it again?
yes. you can want to read it again and still be happy with the help she gave.
write those two ideas together.
thank you for helping me understand that page. i still want to read it again, but it is more clear now.
does your message sound like her help did nothing?
no. it says the page is more clear now. it also says you want to read it again.
what if she asks whether i want her to explain it again right now?
you can tell her whether you want more help now or some time to try reading alone.
i want to try alone first. make the answer kind.
thank you. i would like to try reading it alone first, and i can ask if i need more help.
can i ask for help later without saying i was wrong to try alone?
yes. trying alone and asking for help later can be parts of the same learning.
only give me the thank you again.
thank you for helping me understand that page.
can i say i went to home?
usually you say i went home, without to. with house, you can say i went to the house.
what about i am at home?
that is right. i am at home says where you are.
now make it past.
i was at home.
what if i am talking about my whole family?
we were at home.
can home mean the place where someone lives even if it is not a whole house?
yes. someone can call a room or another place home if that is where they live.
now use house in a sentence about visiting my aunt.
i went to the house of my aunt.
can you make that sound less hard to say?
i went to visit my aunt at her house.
does that mean she was at home when i got there?
not from the sentence alone. it says you went to visit her there, but you might need another detail to know whether she was home.
add that she opened the door when i got there.
i went to visit my aunt at her house, and she opened the door when i got there.
now do we know she was there?
yes. the new detail says she opened the door.
i have two books, and i like both. can i say all of them instead?
yes, with those two books, all of them can mean both. both makes the number two clear.
give me the meaning with the number two.
with those two books, all of them can mean the two together. both makes the number two clear.
now i have three books. can both mean all three?
no. both is for two. all three makes clear that you mean the whole group of three.
what if i like two of the three?
you can say i like two of the three books.
does that say i hate the other one?
no. it does not tell us enough about the other book to say you hate it.
write a question asking which two i like.
which two books do you like?
one is blue and one is green. the other is red.
then you like the blue and green books, from what you said.
can you say i have never read the red one?
no. you gave its color, not whether you have read it.
what if i now say i have not read it yet?
then we know you have not read the red book yet. we still do not know whether you will like it after reading it.
say only the fact about the reading.
you have not read the red book yet.
my friend said she cannot come today. i know she was going to help me with the garden, but i do not know why the plan changed.
you know she cannot come today, but you do not yet know the reason. you can ask whether another day would work if you still want the help.
i do not want to make her explain why. what could i say?
okay. would another day work for you?
she says maybe next week. is that a plan for tomorrow?
no. next week and tomorrow are not the same, and maybe is not a sure choice of a day.
can i still work in the garden today by myself?
yes, if the work is something you can do alone. you do not have to wait just because the visit changed.
i only need to put water on the plants. i can do that.
then you can take care of that part today and leave any work that needs help for another time.
what if i want to say i will be in the garden but she does not need to come?
i will be in the garden for a while, but you do not need to come today. we can choose another time.
keep only the kind part about another time.
we can choose another time when it works for both of us.
does that mean i must choose her day as well as mine?
no. it leaves the day for both of you to choose together.
in my story there are three animals. the small one is in the garden, the large one is near the door, and the other is under a tree. can you say which one is most young?
no. size and place do not tell us how old they are from the information you gave.
explain why in one sentence.
not from the information you gave. you said which one is small and where each one is, but not how old they are.
now i say the large one is old and the small one is young. what do you know about the animal under the tree?
you have not said whether it is old or young.
can i call it the tree animal?
you can use that as a short name in this story if both of us know which animal you mean. it does not have to mean a kind of animal that always lives in trees.
now the animal under the tree moves to the door. how can i keep it apart from the large one already there?
you could call it the animal that was under the tree. that keeps its old place as a way to tell the two apart.
are there now two animals near the door?
yes, if the large one stayed there. you have not said it moved.
write one clear sentence about the move.
the animal that was under the tree moved to the door, where the large animal already was.
does that sentence say the large animal was standing?
no. it says the large animal was at the door, without saying whether it was standing or sitting.
i am trying to write a thank you. do not write it for me yet. ask me one question that will help.
who do you want to thank, and what did they do?
that is two things in one question. ask only who first.
who do you want to thank?
my teacher.
what did your teacher help you with?
reading a hard page. now write a short thank you.
thank you for helping me read that hard page.
can you make it about understanding rather than just reading the words?
thank you for helping me understand that hard page.
now add that i will try the next page on my own.
thank you for helping me understand that hard page. i will try the next page on my own.
does on my own mean nobody can help me later?
no. it says you will try it yourself. it does not stop you from asking for help later.
only give the message, no explanation.
thank you for helping me understand that hard page. i will try the next page on my own.
my brother says i am almost done when he still has two pages left. is almost the same as finished?
no. almost done says there is still some part left. finished says the task is done.
if he closes the book, does that make the task finished?
not by itself. closing the book changes what he is doing with it, not how much of the task he has done.
what if the task was only to read the first four pages and he did that?
then he may have finished the task even if there are more pages in the book. the task and the whole book are not always the same thing.
so i need to know what done is about?
yes. done could mean the whole book or just the part he needed to read.
write one question to check that.
do you mean you finished the whole book or the part you needed to read?
he says the part for school. write that as a fact in my voice.
my brother finished the part he needed to read for school.
but he first said almost done. can both answers be right?
yes, if he finished after that first answer. he could have been almost done before and finished now. but if two pages of the task are still left, he is not finished yet.
use before and now in a short answer.
he could have been almost done before and finished now. but if part of the task is still left, he is not finished yet.
end with only that last idea.
if part of the task is still left, he is not finished yet.
give me a sentence with her book and another with hers.
her book is on the table. the book on the table is hers.
do they have to be about two books?
no. they can both be about the same book.
say it with both sentences.
no. both sentences can be about the same book.
now make it about a man with his.
his book is on the table. the book on the table is his.
why did her change to hers but his stayed his?
her goes before book in these examples, while hers can stand without book after it. his can work in both places in those sentences.
now do mine and my.
my book is on the table. the book on the table is mine.
can i say mine book?
not in that simple sentence. say my book, or say the book is mine.
now ask me whose book is on the table.
whose book is on the table?
mine.
then you can say: my book is on the table.
what if i ask you to tell someone else about my answer?
you could say: the person i asked said it was their book.
we were going to have bread with dinner, but there is no bread left. i have rice ready. i feel like i changed the whole meal.
you changed one part of the meal. what else were you going to have?
soup and vegetables. those are still ready.
then the soup and vegetables can stay the same, and rice can be the new part if everyone is happy with it.
now my sister says she would rather have more soup than rice.
then she can have more soup if there is enough. you do not all have to choose the same food or eat as much as each other.
say that with how much.
you can each choose how much soup or rice you want, if there is enough food for everyone.
does that mean the whole dinner went wrong?
not from what you said. you have food ready and are finding a choice that works with what is there.
give me a shorter answer about the bread.
no. not having bread does not make the whole dinner wrong.
write a short thing i can say at the table.
we do not have bread, but there is rice if you would like some.
can you keep that message without asking everyone a question?
yes. that message gives them a choice without asking a new question.
i finally wrote the letter i was putting off. it is only a few sentences, but i am happy it is done.
a few clear sentences can be enough for a letter. it is good that you finished something you wanted to do.
i do not want to turn this into a plan for writing every day. i just wanted to tell someone.
then we can leave it as a good moment today. you do not have to make a new rule out of it.
can you say something kind about what i finished today?
you did something you had wanted to finish, and you can be happy about it.
now i need to leave for work. no more questions.
goodbye. i hope your day goes well.
can you make it less general and keep it about work?
goodbye. i hope work goes well today.
what if work is hard today too?
then finishing the letter can still be one good part of the day. another hard part does not take it away.
i like that. just give me the goodbye again.
goodbye. i hope work goes well today.
